install_notes_en: Standard 170x75 cm; mixer at 75 cm FFL; provide access panel at the drain end; waterproof under and behind the tub apron before closing.

warnings.message_en: No access panel at the bathtub drain makes any future leak a demolition job.
warnings.message_ar: عدم وجود فتحة صيانة عند صرف البانيو يجعل أي تسريب مستقبلي يتطلب تكسيراً.

install_notes_en: Located at the lowest point of a 1.5-2% floor slope, away from the door and the dry zone; trap must hold a water seal (add trap primer or HDPE seal in rarely used bathrooms).

warnings.message_en: Floor drain near the door means the whole floor slopes toward the exit — water tracks out.
warnings.message_ar: الصفاية قرب الباب تعني ميل الأرضية نحو الخارج — المياه ستخرج من الحمام.

install_notes_en: Angle valve + spray point 60 cm from FFL on the wall beside the WC, reachable from seated position (within 60 cm of WC centerline).
Min enclosure 90x90 cm (80x80 absolute minimum); mixer at 100-110 cm; head at 200-210 cm; floor slope 2% to drain; linear drains need 2 cm recess in screed.

warnings.message_en: Shower smaller than 80x80 cm is unusable for most adults.
warnings.message_ar: دش أصغر من 80×80 سم غير صالح لمعظم البالغين.

install_notes_en: Rim at 82-86 cm FFL; drain rough-in 50-55 cm; supplies 55-60 cm at 20 cm apart. Hot on the left facing the fixture.

warnings.message_en: Hot supply on the right side breaks convention and confuses users.
warnings.message_ar: توصيل الماء الساخن على اليمين يخالف العرف ويربك المستخدم.

install_notes_en: Mount above false ceiling or high wall with drain pan piped to nearest drain; pressure relief valve discharge must be piped, never open; unit needs service access hatch 60x60 cm.

warnings.message_en: Water heater above a gypsum ceiling without a piped drain pan will destroy the ceiling on first leak.
warnings.message_ar: سخان فوق سقف جبس بدون حوض تصريف موصول سيتلف السقف عند أول تسريب.

install_notes_en: Centerline min 38 cm (rec 45 cm) from side wall or nearest fixture; 60 cm clear in front. Wall-hung units need carrier frame rated 400 kg and access to concealed cistern.

warnings.message_en: WC centerline under 38 cm from side wall violates minimum clearance.
warnings.message_ar: محور الكرسي أقل من 38 سم من الجدار الجانبي يخالف الحد الأدنى للخلوص.

install_notes_en: Required even in powder rooms — overflow protection and cleaning.
Same rule as main bathroom.
Compact basin (min 40 cm wide) or corner basin; hot supply optional but recommended for guest comfort.
Compact/short-projection WC (62-65 cm) recommended; min room width 90 cm for a WC-only powder room.
Tee off the sink drain with a high loop or air gap; angle valve inside adjacent cabinet, never behind the machine.

warnings.message_en: Shut-off valve behind the dishwasher is unreachable in an emergency.
warnings.message_ar: محبس الغسالة خلف الجهاز لا يمكن الوصول إليه عند الطوارئ.

install_notes_en: Strongly recommended in Gulf kitchens (wet cleaning habit); slope tiles 1% toward it.
Angle valve behind fridge recess for ice-maker models.
Drain rough-in 50-55 cm; supplies at 55-60 cm inside sink cabinet; keep 90 cm clear counter-front working space; deep-bowl sinks need drain at 45 cm.
Standpipe 60-90 cm FFL with P-trap; only where no laundry room exists.
Feed + dedicated faucet hole + drain tee for RO reject line inside sink cabinet.
For condenser/heat-pump dryers; otherwise provide vent route for vented models.
Non-negotiable — a washer hose failure discharges ~100 L before anyone notices; floor must slope to this drain.

warnings.message_en: Laundry room without a floor drain floods the unit on first hose failure.
warnings.message_ar: غرفة غسيل بدون صفاية أرضية ستغرق الوحدة عند أول تلف في الخرطوم.

install_notes_en: Deep utility sink for hand-wash and mop bucket.
Standpipe 60-90 cm FFL with P-trap; supplies with lever-type angle valves at 105-110 cm beside (not behind) the machine; add water-hammer arrestors.

warnings.message_en: Washer solenoid valves without hammer arrestors bang the pipes on every cycle.
warnings.message_ar: صمامات الغسالة بدون مانع الطرق المائي تسبب طرقاً في المواسير مع كل دورة.
